name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator
description: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a B2B prospecting and social-selling tool built on LinkedIn's own member network, offering advanced lead and account search, AI-powered account and lead insights, InMail messaging, and CRM integrations to help sales professionals find and engage decision-makers.
best_for: Individual B2B sellers and sales teams wanting to prospect and research decision-makers directly on LinkedIn's own network, with AI-assisted account insights and InMail outreach; Advanced Plus adds direct CRM sync for teams standardized on Salesforce or similar.
features: Advanced lead and account search with 40+ filters (function, seniority, years at company) to find decision-makers
InMail messaging, with 50 credits per month included, to reach prospects outside your network
Account IQ and Lead IQ, AI-generated account and lead research summaries, on Advanced and Advanced Plus plans
Buyer Intent signals showing which companies are actively showing interest, on Advanced and Advanced Plus plans
Smart Links for sharing content with prospects and seeing who engages, on Advanced and Advanced Plus plans
Relationship Explorer and TeamLink for surfacing warm paths into target accounts through a team's combined network
Advanced CRM integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Oracle, including direct lead/contact creation, on Advanced Plus
iOS and Android mobile apps for full access to leads, accounts, and insights from a phone
Team seat management and centralized billing for sales teams

pricing.starting_price: $119.99/month per license, or $1,079.88/year per license (Core plan)

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Or $1,079.88/year/license, a stated 25% saving versus monthly billing (equivalent to about $89.99/month). Includes 50 InMails/month and 40+ advanced search filters. LinkedIn's own plan comparison lists this tier as best for individual sellers.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: Or $1,799.88/year/license, a stated 6% saving versus monthly billing. Adds Account IQ & Lead IQ AI insights, Buyer Intent signals, Smart Links, and TeamLink. LinkedIn's own plan comparison lists this tier as best for sales teams.

tiers.name: Advanced Plus
tiers.notes: Custom pricing based on team size, CRM integration, and onboarding/training needs; requires requesting a demo. Adds advanced CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle), direct lead/contact creation to CRM, and ROI reporting. Best for sales teams using an integrated CRM, per LinkedIn's own plan comparison.

pros: Publishes exact self-serve monthly and annual per-license pricing for both the Core and Advanced plans rather than requiring a sales call for its two lower tiers
Built directly on LinkedIn's own member network, with AI-powered Account IQ and Lead IQ research plus Buyer Intent signals on Advanced plans
iOS and Android apps give full access to leads, accounts, and insights from a phone, per its product page
cons: Advanced Plus, the only tier with direct CRM write-back (Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle) and ROI reporting, has no published price and requires requesting a demo
InMail messaging is capped at 50 per month on every tier, including Advanced Plus
Buyer Intent and Smart Links are withheld from the entry Core plan, available only on Advanced and Advanced Plus

faq.question: How much does LinkedIn Sales Navigator cost?
faq.answer: Core is $119.99/month or $1,079.88/year per license (a stated 25% annual saving); Advanced is $159.99/month or $1,799.88/year per license (a stated 6% annual saving); Advanced Plus is custom-priced and requires requesting a demo.

faq.question: Does LinkedIn Sales Navigator offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Its product pages include "Start your free trial" calls to action and a dedicated FAQ on how to sign up for a free trial, though the exact trial length is not stated on the marketing pages reviewed.

faq.question: What is Account IQ?
faq.answer: Account IQ is described as an AI-powered feature that cuts research time by generating instant account and lead insights, available on the Advanced and Advanced Plus plans.

alternatives.name: Apollo.io
alternatives.description: A sales intelligence and engagement platform combining a B2B contact database with sequencing, a dialer, and AI-assisted prospecting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a free plan and published self-serve pricing alongside a bundled dialer/sequencing layer.

alternatives.name: ZoomInfo Sales
alternatives.description: A B2B sales intelligence product combining a large contact/company database with buyer intent, website-visitor tracking, and conversation intelligence.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a very large direct-dial contact database alongside intent data and engagement automation.

alternatives.name: Cognism
alternatives.description: A B2B sales intelligence platform built around phone-verified contact data and buying-intent signals, with a compliance-first approach for European and global prospecting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams prioritizing compliance-vetted, phone-verified mobile numbers over social-network-based prospecting.
